content_data.project_description: Enterprise-grade integration platform to unify player authentication and profile data across multiple gaming platforms and third-party services. This system will enable seamless player experiences while maintaining data consistency and security compliance across North American operations.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1: Architecture & Design (months 1-3), Phase 2: Core Development (months 4-9), Phase 3: Integration & Testing (months 10-12), Phase 4: Deployment & Stabilization (months 13-14)
objectives: Implement GDPR and CCPA compliant data handling workflows
Enable real-time profile synchronization across minimum 8 gaming platforms
Establish unified player identity framework supporting OAuth 2.0, SAML, and proprietary authentication protocols
deliverables: Distributed session management system with Redis clustering
Security audit report and penetration testing results
RESTful and GraphQL API layer with comprehensive documentation
Automated testing suite with 85% code coverage minimum
Integration SDKs for Unity, Unreal Engine, and web platforms
resources_needed: New Relic or Datadog licenses for observability and monitoring
5 backend engineers specializing in distributed systems
AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, RDS instances, and ElastiCache
Security scanning tools including OWASP ZAP and Snyk

memory_deletes.removed_item: Disaster recovery and failover procedures documentation
2 DevOps engineers with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure expertise
